AnyResource.description: A FHIR resource of any type. Not described further here.

Bundle.description: A container for a collection of resources.

implicitRules.description: A set of rules under which this content was created

type.description: document | message | transaction | transaction-response | batch | batch-response | history | searchset | collection | subscription-notification

total.description: If search, the total number of matches

entry.description: Entry in the bundle - will have a resource or information

Bundle_Entry.description: An entry in a bundle resource - will either contain a resource or information about a resource (transactions and history only).

modifierExtension.description: Extensions that cannot be ignored even if unrecognized

fullUrl.description: URI for resource (e.g. the absolute URL server address, URI for UUID/OID, etc.)

Bundle_Entry_Request.description: Additional information about how this entry should be processed as part of a transaction or batch.  For history, it shows how the entry was processed to create the version contained in the entry.

modifierExtension.description: Extensions that cannot be ignored even if unrecognized

method.description: GET | HEAD | POST | PUT | DELETE | PATCH

url.description: URL for HTTP equivalent of this entry

Bundle_Entry_Response.description: Indicates the results of processing the corresponding 'request' entry in the batch or transaction being responded to or what the results of an operation where when returning history.

modifierExtension.description: Extensions that cannot be ignored even if unrecognized

location.description: The location (if the operation returns a location)

etag.description: The Etag for the resource (if relevant)

outcome.description: OperationOutcome with hints and warnings (for batch/transaction)

Bundle_Entry_Search.description: Information about the search process that lead to the creation of this entry.

modifierExtension.description: Extensions that cannot be ignored even if unrecognized

mode.description: match | include - why this is in the result set

Bundle_Link.description: A series of links that provide context to this bundle.

modifierExtension.description: Extensions that cannot be ignored even if unrecognized

CodeableConcept.description: CodeableConcept Type: A concept that may be defined by a formal reference to a terminology or ontology or may be provided by text.

coding.description: Code defined by a terminology system

text.description: Plain text representation of the concept

Coding.description: Coding Type: A reference to a code defined by a terminology system.

version.description: Version of the system - if relevant

code.description: Symbol in syntax defined by the system

userSelected.description: If this coding was chosen directly by the user

Element.description: Element Type: Base definition for all elements in a resource.

Extension.description: An extension. The value (value[x]) can be any FHIR datatype, and is not described further here.

^_?value[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]*$.description: The value (value[x]), and its _value[x] sibling for a primitive

Identifier.description: Identifier Type: An identifier - identifies some entity uniquely and unambiguously. Typically this is used for business identifiers.

use.description: usual | official | temp | secondary | old (If known)

system.description: The namespace for the identifier value

period.description: Time period when id is/was valid for use

assigner.description: Organization that issued id (may be just text)

Meta.description: Meta Type: The metadata about a resource. This is content in the resource that is maintained by the infrastructure. Changes to the content might not always be associated with version changes to the resource.

lastUpdated.description: When the resource version last changed

source.description: Identifies where the resource comes from

profile.description: Profiles this resource claims to conform to

security.description: Security Labels applied to this resource

Narrative.description: Narrative Type: A human-readable summary of the resource conveying the essential clinical and business information for the resource.

OperationOutcome.description: A collection of error, warning, or information messages that result from a system action.

implicitRules.description: A set of rules under which this content was created

text.description: Text summary of the resource, for human interpretation

issue.description: A single issue associated with the action

OperationOutcome_Issue.description: An error, warning, or information message that results from a system action.

modifierExtension.description: Extensions that cannot be ignored even if unrecognized

diagnostics.description: Additional diagnostic information about the issue

location.description: Deprecated: Path of element(s) related to issue

expression.description: FHIRPath of element(s) related to issue

Period.description: Period Type: A time period defined by a start and end date and optionally time.

end.description: End time with inclusive boundary, if not ongoing

Reference.description: Reference Type: A reference from one resource to another.

reference.description: Literal reference, Relative, internal or absolute URL

type.description: Type the reference refers to (e.g. "Patient") - must be a resource in resources

identifier.description: Logical reference, when literal reference is not known

Signature.description: Signature Type: A signature along with supporting context. The signature may be a digital signature that is cryptographic in nature, or some other signature acceptable to the domain. This other signature may be as simple as a graphical image representing a hand-written signature, or a signature ceremony Different signature approaches have different utilities.

type.description: Indication of the reason the entity signed the object(s)

targetFormat.description: The technical format of the signed resources

sigFormat.description: The technical format of the signature

data.description: The actual signature content (XML DigSig. JWS, picture, etc.)

TestReport.description: A TestReport, as this server accepts it: an R5 TestReport (or an R4 one - see testScript), with name, tester, issued and at least one participant, and no contained resources.

implicitRules.description: A set of rules under which this content was created

text.description: Text summary of the resource, for human interpretation

name.description: Informal name of the executed TestReport

testScript.description: The TestScript that was run: a canonical (R5), or a Reference (R4)

score.description: The final score (percentage of tests passed) resulting from the execution of the TestScript

tester.description: Name of the tester producing this report (Organization or individual)

issued.description: When the TestScript was executed and this TestReport was generated

participant.description: A participant in the test execution, either the execution engine, a client, or a server

setup.description: The results of the series of required setup operations before the tests were executed

test.description: A test executed from the test script

teardown.description: The results of running the series of required clean up steps

TestReport_Participant.description: A participant in the test execution, either the execution engine, a client, or a server.

modifierExtension.description: Extensions that cannot be ignored even if unrecognized

uri.description: The uri of the participant. An absolute URL is preferred

display.description: The display name of the participant

TestReport_Setup.description: The results of the series of required setup operations before the tests were executed.

modifierExtension.description: Extensions that cannot be ignored even if unrecognized

action.description: A setup operation or assert that was executed

TestReport_Setup_Action.description: Action would contain either an operation or an assertion.

modifierExtension.description: Extensions that cannot be ignored even if unrecognized

TestReport_Setup_Action_Assert.description: The results of the assertion performed on the previous operations.

modifierExtension.description: Extensions that cannot be ignored even if unrecognized

message.description: A message associated with the result

detail.description: A link to further details on the result

requirement.description: Links or references to the testing requirements

TestReport_Setup_Action_Assert_Requireme.description: Links or references providing traceability to the testing requirements for this assert.

modifierExtension.description: Extensions that cannot be ignored even if unrecognized

linkUri.description: Link or reference to the testing requirement

linkCanonical.description: Link or reference to the testing requirement

modifierExtension.description: Extensions that cannot be ignored even if unrecognized

message.description: A message associated with the result

detail.description: A link to further details on the result

TestReport_Teardown.description: The results of the series of operations required to clean up after all the tests were executed (successfully or otherwise).

modifierExtension.description: Extensions that cannot be ignored even if unrecognized

action.description: One or more teardown operations performed

TestReport_Teardown_Action.description: The teardown action will only contain an operation.

modifierExtension.description: Extensions that cannot be ignored even if unrecognized

TestReport_Test.description: A test executed from the test script.

modifierExtension.description: Extensions that cannot be ignored even if unrecognized

description.description: Tracking/reporting short description of the test

action.description: A test operation or assert that was performed

TestReport_Test_Action.description: Action would contain either an operation or an assertion.

modifierExtension.description: Extensions that cannot be ignored even if unrecognized
